summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery content in sync vscode plugin version

delivery.outcome: Rename the generic file-text local 'content' to stage-accurate names in each of the five reader/writer functions of scripts/sync-vscode-plugin-version.py: version_source (plugin_version.py text), package_text (package.json text), workflow_text (native-ide-matrix.yml text). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the groups become 2/2/1 and the smell disappears. Pure rename inside function bodies, no behavior change. Adds tests for the three previously untested functions so every renamed scope is executed.
nonGoals: No behavior, CLI, regex or output change in the script
No restructuring into shared read/regex/write helpers (the five functions read different files with different semantics; the shared name was the defect, not missing abstraction)
No changes to scripts/sync-plugin-version.py or any other script

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local renames only: content -> version_source in get_plugin_version_from_source and update_plugin_version_source; content -> package_text in get_plugin_version_from_package and update_package_json; content -> workflow_text in update_github_workflow. The 'updated' local (3 scopes) stays under the >= 5 threshold and is left untouched for minimality. Verified on plain /tmp copies with the exact code2llm invocation that generated PLF-041: baseline reproduces the smell, the renamed tree clears it with no new smells (124 -> 123 shotgun findings).
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the five locals are named content again and the smell report returns.

validation.evidence: Re-scan of a plain copy of the merged tree with the same invocation that generated the planfile ticket: no shotgun_surgery entry for scripts/sync-vscode-plugin-version.py and no new smell for that file (total shotgun findings drop by exactly one).
4 passed (2 existing + 2 new) and ruff clean on both touched files.
